Service examples as supplied

Original scope & pricing.

These inherited examples are preserved for review. Current scope, timing, fees, and engagement terms are agreed in a project proposal.

  • Biosecurity Risk Assessment · 2-4 weeks · Contact for pricing
  • Evolutionary Modeling · 4-8 weeks · Contact for pricing
  • Strategic Consulting · Hourly or project-based · $300/hour
  • Rapid Assessment · 2-3 days · Starting at $2,500

Additional examples in the original translations: basic assessment, $5,000 USD; comprehensive analysis, $15,000 USD; ongoing partnership, custom pricing.
